memories.body: Workspace skill files live under agent-skills/ in the workspace root (e.g., C:\Users\Admin\OneDrive\Documentos\Prompt Engineering\agent-skills\web-designer\SKILL.md). The .config/opencode/skills/ directory is a mirror. ALWAYS edit the workspace copy (agent-skills/) and then copy to .config/ if needed, or edit both. Never edit only .config.
